name: Daraku Otome Ibun -Ochitaru Yuusha to Shinjitsu no Maken-
original_name: 堕落乙女異聞―堕ちたる勇者と真実の魔剣―
source:
Eristia Vitral, the last hero of the Order in Lescatie, sets out on an adventure through the ruins of the Order as she seeks out a powerful artifact, "Magic Sword of Truth", with her faithful squire Yuriy. From her efforts, she'll learn more about the Order and the "truth" within herself than she ever bargained for...

[From [url=http://monstergirlencyclopedia.wikia.com/wiki/Another_Story_of_Fallen_Maidens:_Fallen_Hero_and_the_Magic_Sword_of_Truth]Wikia[/url]]
translation:
埃里斯蒂娅·维特拉尔是莱斯卡蒂教团的最后一位英雄，她和她忠实的侍从尤里一起踏上了穿越教团废墟的冒险之旅，寻找一把强大的神器“真理魔剑”。通过她的努力，她将比她预想的更多地了解凤凰社和自己内心的“真相”……

[来自[url=http://monstergirlencyclopedia.wikia.com/wiki/Another_Story_of_Fallen_Maidens:_Fallen_Hero_and_the_Magic_Sword_of_Truth]Wikia[/url]]
